name: web-split-proportion-bar-apples-30-percent-oranges-70-percent
title: Single horizontal bar split into a black 30% segment 'Apples' and a grey 70% segment 'Oranges' with labels beneath
whatItIs: A white frame with a pill-shaped horizontal bar divided into a short black part and a long mid-grey part, and below them centred labels 'Apples 30%' (bold black) and 'Oranges 70%' (grey).
whatItMeans: Direct and simple; one bar tells the ratio without a legend.
techniques: Split one bar into proportional segments.
Match label weight to segment colour.

vocabulary.definition: A bar divided by shares of a whole.
Text under a segment naming it and its value.
A bar with fully rounded ends.
Black and grey used for two categories.
